item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "5bfde5685f91eb0365e4a6aa84b59564a8300282276676d3e27899bee4606b52",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "The real-valued specialization of LocalDef003, with its four arguments unchanged.",
      "effect_on_target": "The left side asserts existence of both coordinate derivatives at (x,t), satisfying qt + speed*qx = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "The real-valued specialization of LocalDef003, with its four arguments unchanged.",
      "effect_on_target": "The right side is definitionally identical to the left side; renaming formal parameters changes no condition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "For a function q from two real arguments to a real normed vector space E, there exist qt and qx in E such that the derivative of τ ↦ q(x,τ) at t is qt, the derivative of ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) at x is qx, and qt + speed • qx = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specialized to E = R, this supplies the same pointwise derivative-existence and derivative-equation condition on both sides.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "Scalar multiplication by real numbers is jointly continuous on every real normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies a structural continuity instance needed for the derivative predicate; it imposes no continuity hypothesis on field.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "Iff",
      "meaning": "Logical equivalence: each proposition implies the other.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects two definitionally identical propositions, so the conclusion is P if and only if P.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "Extracts the strict comparison relation from an LT instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses the hypothesis 0 < speed using real strict order.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral in a type using its specified numeral instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the displayed numeral 0 as real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The type of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both arguments and the value of field, and speed, x, and t, are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "The strict-order instance on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the speed hypothesis strict positivity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The zero instance on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real zero in the positivity hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 using the zero of the ambient type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures that numeral zero denotes the appropriate additive zero in the hypothesis and derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A normed field is a normed vector space over itself, with scalar multiplication given by field multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes speed • qx ordinary real multiplication speed*qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The real numbers with their usual additive commutative group, norm, and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the normed additive structure for the real-valued derivative witnesses and their sum.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The usual real field equipped with its norm and compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real arithmetic and the normed-field structure used for scalar multiplication and differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Constructs a SubtractionCommMonoid from an additive commutative group, preserving addition, subtraction, and negation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports inherited additive operations and zero; despite its name, it introduces no division into the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "AddCommMagma.toAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts the addition operation from a commutative additive magma.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the addition used in qt + speed • qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Forgets the identity requirement of a commutative additive monoid while retaining its associative, commutative addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the addition used in the derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma",
      "meaning": "Extracts the commutative addition structure from a commutative additive semigroup.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an inheritance step to the addition operation in the derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition and its zero identity from an additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the additive zero in the derivative equation without adding a hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "AddZero.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts zero from a structure carrying addition and zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the zero on the right side of the derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "AddZeroClass.toAddZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts the addition and zero operations from an additive zero-identity structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the zero and addition used in the equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction, requiring both component propositions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires the time-slice derivative, the space-slice derivative, and their equation simultaneously.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "A densely normed field carries a nontrivial norm, and this construction retains its normed-field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the nontrivially normed real scalar field required by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication preserving zero and addition from a distributive multiplicative action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the scalar multiplication in speed • qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication and its preservation of zero from distributive scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the action used to multiply qx by speed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets the norm-separation requirement of an extended-normed additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited additive structure without changing the underlying real operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative monoid underlying an extended-seminormed additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary addition and zero for the derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity from an extended-seminormed additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an inheritance route to the same additive operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying additive monoid from an extended-seminormed additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies addition and zero without additional analytic assumptions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two elements of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires exact equality qt + speed*qx = 0, not an estimate or approximation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over an element satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Quantifies qt first and qx second inside each side of the equivalence; witnesses may depend on field, speed, x, and t, and the second witness may be chosen after the first.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts a possibly heterogeneous addition operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here both operands and the result lie in the same space E, specialized to R.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts a possibly heterogeneous scalar multiplication operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Acts by the real scalar speed on qx; in the target this is real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The ordinary derivative predicate at a point, defined through HasDerivAtFilter on the product of the neighborhood filter at that point and the pure filter fixing the base point.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires genuine derivatives of the two real coordinate slices at the specified points, with no restriction to a subset and no one-sided derivative.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action underlying a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real vector-space structure to the scalar multiplication in the equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "NegZeroClass.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts zero from a structure with negation preserving zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides another inheritance route to the same additive zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "An additive commutative group equipped with a norm and compatible metric satisfying dist(a,b) = norm(a-b).",
      "effect_on_target": "Describes the generic codomain structure of LocalDef003; the target uses its standard real instance and does not quantify over arbitrary codomains.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative group underlying a normed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive structure required for derivatives and the derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toENormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Views a normed additive commutative group as an extended-normed additive commutative monoid with the induced extended norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports structural inheritance of addition and zero, without changing the target's real-valued domain or codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Views a normed additive commutative group as seminormed, retaining its norm, additive group, and induced pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the structure needed for the normed-space and topology instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "NormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A module over a normed field with a compatible seminorm, satisfying the scalar norm bound.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes LocalDef003 meaningful for real normed vector spaces; here the codomain is the canonical real space over itself.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure from a normed space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar multiplication needed by HasDerivAt and by speed • qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure induced by a pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms part of the route to the topology used for derivative limits.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real normed field has elements whose norms lie between any two strictly ordered nonnegative real bounds.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides nontriviality of the real norm for the derivative infrastructure; adds no restriction on field or speed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "Real.instMonoid",
      "meaning": "The inferred multiplicative monoid structure of the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the multiplicative scalar action underlying real scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The inferred semiring structure of the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real addition and multiplication for the module structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "SMulZeroClass.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from an action preserving zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the underlying scalar operation in speed • qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric structure from a seminormed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the metric-derived topology used in differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "SubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains zero, negation, and the law that the negative of zero is zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports inherited zero; imposes no further target condition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "SubtractionCommMonoid.toSubtractionMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity from a commutative subtraction monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the additive operations used by subsequent structure projections.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "SubtractionMonoid.toSubNegZeroMonoid",
      "meaning": "Constructs the subtraction-and-negation structure with negation preserving zero from a subtraction monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an inheritance route to additive zero, without introducing an extra equation in the proposition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology underlying a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the topology for the neighborhood filters and continuity structure used by derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Uses an ordinary addition operation as heterogeneous addition with identical input and output types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the displayed sum is ordinary addition in E, here R.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "instHSMul",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary scalar multiplication as heterogeneous scalar multiplication with the same vector input and output type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the displayed scalar product is the normed space's usual action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts an additive commutative monoid from an additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves addition and zero for the equation and module structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive group underlying an additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited additive operations without changing their interpretation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition, subtraction, and negation structure from an additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports additive structure inheritance used in the derivative predicate and equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "ContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "The scalar action map (a,v) ↦ a • v is jointly continuous in the specified topologies.",
      "effect_on_target": "A structural requirement for HasDerivAt, supplied automatically for the normed space; it does not assert continuity of field.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts a semiring from a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar arithmetic structure used by the real module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Views a field as a semifield, retaining its semiring and multiplicative inverse structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an inheritance route for real scalar arithmetic without adding target assumptions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts a multiplicative monoid from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the monoid structure needed for the scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts a normed field from a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Keeps the scalar field and norm consistent across derivative and module structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying field from a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real field operations used by the scalar and derivative infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real pseudometric is dist(x,y) = |x-y|, with its compatible uniform structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "The derivatives use the ordinary real topology and ordinary limits.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts a division semiring from a semifield, preserving arithmetic and inverses.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a structural route to the semiring used for scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts multiplication, its identity, and absorbing zero from a semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the multiplicative structure underlying the scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "SubNegMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid underlying a subtraction-and-negation monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the addition and zero used in the derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "For every function field : R → R → R, equivalently a real-valued function of an ordered pair of real variables.",
      "For every real speed, every real x, and every real t.",
      "Under the hypothesis 0 < speed.",
      "Inside each side of the equivalence, there exist real numbers qt and qx, in that order. These witnesses are local to that side and may depend on the outer parameters; qx may be chosen after qt."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "The real parameter speed is strictly positive.",
      "There are no regularity hypotheses on field and no restrictions on x or t."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "There exist qt,qx ∈ R such that τ ↦ field(x,τ) has derivative qt at t, ξ ↦ field(ξ,t) has derivative qx at x, and qt + speed*qx = 0, if and only if there exist qt,qx ∈ R satisfying those exact same three conditions.",
      "The two sides are definitionally identical; the equivalence asserts neither side independently."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "Let P(field,speed,x,t) mean ∃ qt ∈ R, ∃ qx ∈ R, [the derivative of τ ↦ field(x,τ) at t equals qt] ∧ ([the derivative of ξ ↦ field(ξ,t) at x equals qx] ∧ [qt + speed*qx = 0]).",
      "Equivalently, the derivative conditions are lim_{h→0, h≠0} (field(x,t+h)-field(x,t))/h = qt and lim_{h→0, h≠0} (field(x+h,t)-field(x,t))/h = qx.",
      "Both LocalDef001 and LocalDef002 denote P, by unfolding their common definition LocalDef003.",
      "LocalDef003 is defined more generally for values in any real normed vector space, using vector addition, scalar multiplication, and vector zero. In this target its codomain is R with the usual structures."
    ],
    "proposition_plain_english": "For every real-valued function field of two real variables, every positive real speed, and every pair (x,t) of real numbers, the condition that both coordinate derivatives exist at (x,t) and satisfy ∂field/∂t(x,t) + speed·∂field/∂x(x,t) = 0 is equivalent to that same condition. Thus the declaration asserts P ↔ P under a positivity hypothesis."
  },
  "restrictions_and_vacuity_risks": [
    "The stated implication only requires the equivalence for speed > 0. This restriction is unnecessary for the displayed self-equivalence, which holds for every real speed.",
    "For speed ≤ 0 the antecedent is false, so the implication is vacuous.",
    "The field is defined on all of R × R; x and t are unrestricted real numbers, with no boundary, interval, or nonnegative-time restriction.",
    "The derivative condition concerns the two coordinate slices at one specified pair (x,t). It does not require joint differentiability, joint continuity, continuous partial derivatives, or differentiability throughout a neighborhood.",
    "If either required derivative fails to exist, or their equation fails, both sides are false and their equivalence still holds.",
    "The universal quantification over x and t asserts the self-equivalence at every point; it does not assert that the derivative equation holds at any point or everywhere.",
    "There is no existence assertion for a field satisfying the derivative equation, no initial or boundary data, no solution formula, and no uniqueness or propagation conclusion.",
    "The symbols x, t, and speed serve as real parameters. Physical interpretations, units, and any independent meaning for the two named predicates are not encoded.",
    "The generic normed-space binders in LocalDef003 do not generalize the target beyond real-valued fields."
  ],
  "ambiguities": []
}
